form.label: Okta System Log - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed Okta System Log JSON relay overview. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk JSON/search-time knowledge; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=netauth sourcetype="okta:system:*" host=$host_tok$ (result="DENY" OR action="DENY" OR severity="WARN") | stats count
index=netauth sourcetype IN ("okta:system:lifecycle","okta:system:policy","okta:system:api_token","okta:system:app","okta:system:risk") host=$host_tok$ | stats count

panel.title: Events over time by Okta family

search.query: index=netauth sourcetype="okta:system:*" host=$host_tok$ | eval okta_family=case(sourcetype="okta:system:authn","authn",sourcetype="okta:system:mfa","mfa",sourcetype="okta:system:lifecycle","lifecycle",sourcetype="okta:system:policy","policy",sourcetype="okta:system:api_token","api_token",sourcetype="okta:system:app","app",sourcetype="okta:system:risk","risk",true(),sourcetype) | timechart count by okta_family

index=netauth sourcetype="okta:system:*" host=$host_tok$ | eval okta_family=case(sourcetype="okta:system:authn","authn",sourcetype="okta:system:mfa","mfa",sourcetype="okta:system:lifecycle","lifecycle",sourcetype="okta:system:policy","policy",sourcetype="okta:system:api_token","api_token",sourcetype="okta:system:app","app",sourcetype="okta:system:risk","risk",true(),sourcetype) | stats count by okta_family | sort -count
index=netauth sourcetype="okta:system:*" host=$host_tok$ | eval outcome=coalesce(result, action, severity, event_type) | stats count by outcome | sort -count | head 20
index=netauth sourcetype="okta:system:*" host=$host_tok$ | eval okta_user=coalesce(user, 'actor.alternateId', actor_display_name, actor_id) | stats count by okta_user | sort -count | head 20
index=netauth sourcetype="okta:system:*" host=$host_tok$ | eval source_ip=coalesce(src_ip, src, 'client.ipAddress') | stats count by source_ip | sort -count | head 20

index=netauth sourcetype IN ("okta:system:authn","okta:system:mfa") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host user src_ip event_type result result_reason session_id user_agent credential_type authentication_provider signature marker | sort -_time | head 100

panel.title: User lifecycle, policy, and API token changes

search.query: index=netauth sourcetype IN ("okta:system:lifecycle","okta:system:policy","okta:system:api_token","okta:system:app","okta:system:risk") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host user src_ip event_type result object object_id object_type target_user policy_id oauth_client_id grant_type scopes session_id request_id signature marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=netauth sourcetype IN ("okta:system:app","okta:system:risk") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host user src_ip event_type result severity object object_id object_type target_user session_id request_id signature marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=netauth sourcetype="okta:system:*" host=$host_tok$ | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

panel.title: Recent raw Okta System Log events

search.query: index=netauth sourcetype="okta:system:*" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype event_type event_id user actor_display_name actor_id src_ip action result result_reason severity signature object object_id object_type target_user credential_type authentication_provider policy_id oauth_client_id grant_type scopes session_id user_agent request_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
